concerns.text: FR-001 requires a fallback when fewer than 10 usable samples are obtained (descriptive analysis & preliminary report). No task implements this fallback, so the requirement is weakened.

SC-004 specifies that the data‑ingestion success rate must be ≥ 95 %. The verification for T002 only checks file existence and schema validity; it does not assert the success‑rate threshold, leaving the success criterion untestable.

FR-009 mandates estimation of charge‑carrier diffusion lengths (from TRPL or empirical calibration) and inclusion in modeling. No task in the list produces a diffusion‑length CSV or performs this estimation, violating the functional requirement.

The implementation plan adds a composite‑metric sensitivity analysis (variance‑weighted and expert‑assigned composites) that is not present in the specification. Introducing this unstated requirement constitutes scope creep and weakens the original spec.

FR-006 requires the final CSV report to contain the fields ‘best‑fit decay model’ and ‘AIC score’. T009’s verification only checks file existence and traceability, not the presence of these mandatory columns, risking omission of required information.

Constitution Principle VI demands that raw EDS maps be stored under `data/raw/`. The task descriptions for data acquisition (T001, T002) never state that downloaded raw maps are saved to this location, potentially violating the data‑hygiene requirement.
